WELCOME TO NOTDRED.IO

notdred.io controls

A small physics sandbox. Walk through your ship, arrange interior blocks, then take the helm and leave the dock.

A/D
Accelerate left/right
Space
Jump; hold for more height
W/S on ladder
Snap to center, climb; A/D locked
Space on ladder
Jump off and unlock movement
E
Use helm or nearby fabricator
WASD at helm
Thrust; rotation is locked
Space at helm
Brake using available thrusters
1–5 / B
Quick slots / all items
Q / click loose item
Drop stack / pick up
Wrench + left click
Dismantle a tile
Right click
Dismantle tile or attachment
R
Rotate held piece; wrench + R rotates hovered object
H
Move helm
F2 / Dev
Give yourself 100 Iron

Walkways block players from every direction; items fall through. Nets stop items, not players. Equip craftable items from Inventory. Fabricators occupy 2×3 cells. Normal thrusters and turrets occupy three hull tiles. Walkways fill one complete tile. Equip fuel/explosives and click a normal thruster to load it. Fuel is craftable; explosives are a resource. Load standard ammo by holding it and clicking an RC turret. Shift-click a turret (or click with empty hands) to eject its ammo inside the ship. Building takes 0.28–0.55 seconds; changing tools or moving out of reach cancels it without spending items. At the helm in a combat zone (Finch I, Finch II, Sparrow I), click outside the ship to aim and fire. RCs only fire into their outward hemisphere. Each rock tile has a 25% chance to drop 16 Iron; diamond turret ore also drops an RC. Docks latch on contact; thrust away to undock. Two starter thrusters provide free basic movement. Fly to the cyan portal and press Q at the helm to travel; Q on foot still drops items. Nearby world loot enters item hatches and comes out as physical stacks. One starter hatch is supplied; additional hatches cost 8 Iron. The helm occupies 2×2 tiles. Aim a resizing item inside the ship: the purple line previews a cut. R switches its axis. Click inserts or removes a one-tile strip; clear occupied strips before shrinking. Empty expando boxes are 2×2 physics bodies. Equip a shredder and click a loose stack to destroy it. Ejectors cost 8 Iron: place beside the inner hull, use R to point outward, then click with a carried stack or drop items onto it. Green bots live in Sparrow and drop flux crystals. Flux crafts the handheld pusher (equip it and click cargo to push) and the stationary pusher (place it, R to aim its beam). RC turrets are mined, never crafted. Standard ammo crafts from 1 Iron + 1 Explosive. Larger ships need more thrusters to maintain speed. Any item can be dropped with Q and picked up. Machines only take items you click them with (a fabricator takes only its ingredients), or what a loader feeds them. Equip an item and click the machine to load it, or drop it into the machine. Recipes use prototype Iron costs.

Inventory / equip

Five actual slots. Materials stack to 16; tools and packaged machines stack to 1. Drag slots to move items; Shift-drag splits stacks. Q drops the selected stack. Overflow stays on the floor.
